lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah to stand at the gate of the people and at all the other gates of Jerusalem.
The LORD says the people must not carry a load through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day.
The LORD commanded the forefathers to keep the Sabbath, but they stiffened their necks and would not receive His blessing.
If the people keep the Sabbath holy, kings and princes will sit on the throne of Saul, riding chariots.
If the people do not listen, the LORD says He will kindle an unquenchable fire in the gates of Jerusalem.
